<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**3** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **222** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **159** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **159**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **170** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 26c965cb8f61ca59804d55e27e737bf7ff91b383` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `6337c092fbfff6e1f12d1da144adb1ac43b05c7a` — the merge of head `7cf467745e681280fc3a6a7130f10ec308c61c8c` into base `26c965cb8f61ca59804d55e27e737bf7ff91b383`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 6337c092fbfff6e1f12d1da144adb1ac43b05c7a && git checkout 6337c092fbfff6e1f12d1da144adb1ac43b05c7a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 26c965cb8f61ca59804d55e27e737bf7ff91b383 7cf467745e681280fc3a6a7130f10ec308c61c8c && git checkout -B drift-repro 26c965cb8f61ca59804d55e27e737bf7ff91b383 && git merge --no-ff 7cf467745e681280fc3a6a7130f10ec308c61c8c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 26c965cb8f61ca59804d55e27e737bf7ff91b383
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `87404ae27500d18285c27708b4383ab88581a28f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md + packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.test.ts, packages/triggers/trigger-record-change/src/record-change-trigger.ts, packages/triggers/trigger-record-change/README.md, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-crud.ts, content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx, content/docs/automation/flows.mdx, skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json, .changeset/30759-notify-click-through-before-create.md

Inputs: card #30759 (body + 4 comments: the sequencing note 6674423070, triage 6674582930, the claim 6683585123, the os-dev-report 6684368393), PR #30926 (body, 7-file list, net diff `origin/main...87404ae2`), the check-runs on `87404ae2`. The dispatch order was not read.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set of `NotifyConfigSchema`: unchanged — right.** The hunks in `io-node-config.zod.ts` touch one docblock bullet (:645-657) and two `.describe()` strings (:766, :775). No key, optional-ness, union arm, default or `superRefine` moves; `notifyLiteralStringSchema('sourceObject')` and `NotifySourceIdSlotSchema` are the same schemas as on `main`. What a notify config parses to is identical before and after.
- **Published surface: description text only — right.** The two describes feed the JSON-schema `description` and the generated reference page; the regenerated `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx` :106-107 carries the new describe strings byte-for-byte (read against the describes at the head). No field is added or removed from the reference table.
- **Runtime: unchanged — right.** `defaultClickThroughOf` (:183-191) and `triggerRecordOf` (:155-159) are the same code as on `main`; the one executable hunk in `notify-node.ts` is the text of a thrown failure (:712), a message, not a code. The node-registration `description` strings (:888, :892) are Studio form text.
- **The enumeration against the tree — right.** On a `beforeInsert` run `buildContext` has no `ctx.result` and no `ctx.previous`, so `record` is `ctx.input.data` (`record-change-trigger.ts` :477-485); the engine hands that hook `input.data` = the defaulted row (`engine.ts` :5540-5543), and `applyFieldDefaults` fills declared `defaultValue`s only, never an id; the id is minted at the write by the driver (`memory-driver.ts` :845 `data.id || this.generateId(object)`; `sql-driver-crud.ts` :259 `toInsert.id = nanoid(...)`); `triggerRecordOf` needs `record.id`. So "links only when the caller wrote the id" is what the tree does on both shipped driver families. `record-before-create` → `beforeInsert` and `record-before-write` → `beforeInsert` + `beforeUpdate` (trigger README :40, :43), so "a before-create" covers both shapes the card names.
- **The `null` clause against the tree — right.** `resolveStringSlot` returns `value: undefined` for a `null` envelope (:707), and `defaultClickThroughOf` is handed the parsed config, where `cfg.sourceId != null` is the written envelope (:188, :1027), so the default is suppressed and no `source` is written: "a written `sourceId` that resolves to nothing, so the pair is dropped rather than defaulted" is exact.
- **Pins (lane seat's file, read as the first consumer of the claim).** The new `beforeInsert` test feeds a context straight to `engine.execute` with `record: { name: 'Pump' }` and no id; it pins `triggerRecordOf` + `defaultClickThroughOf`, not the trigger's `buildContext`. Enough for the card's pin ("writes no `source_object` / `source_id`"); the trigger side is covered by the cited code, not by a test in this PR. The second pin (caller-written id links) is the converse. Right.
- **Rest of the diff** (flows.mdx, the test, the changeset, the regenerated reference): the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body and in `.changeset/30759-notify-click-through-before-create.md`; the changeset bumps `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/service-automation` and `@objectstack/skills` (`packages/skills/package.json`) as **patch**. The diff publishes description text and a failure-message string and nothing that changes an accept-set, so patch is the level and the `Clause-②: no` line is true. The `fixed` group in `.changeset/config.json` already ties spec and skills together. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions: []`. Deviations and out-of-scope findings in the os-dev-report, each answered:

1. `check:dev-prereqs` exit 1 before the workspace build — a box precondition, not a tree finding. Accepted.
2. Full workspace build taken to meet two gates' prerequisites — process, no tree effect. Accepted.
3. Two older unconsumed changesets (`.changeset/30254-…`, `.changeset/30689-…`) repeat "a record change other than a delete" — they are the release input of merged PRs and are compiled chronologically beside this one, whose prose states the correction. Not edited here; accepted, no escalation.
4. No GitHub MCP write tools; assignees/labels set at hand-over — process. Accepted.
5. Open PR #30866 touches `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` at other hunks and is still open at review time; no overlap with :125. The later lander merges `main` and carries the token ratchet (this PR reports headroom 3 on the skill). Accepted; the ratchet is the later lander's constraint, not this PR's.
- `security_findings: none` — agreed, prose only.
- README mapping-table observation — read, agrees with `record-change-trigger.ts`; not a defect.

Tier H (`skills/**`): approval by `os-zhuang` is owed after this record, per the claim; not this record's to give.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`** — judged against the card's ruling (four texts, one shared wording; a before-create run has no id until the driver issues one) and its first consumers (`defaultClickThroughOf` / `triggerRecordOf` in `notify-node.ts`, the generated reference page).

- The docblock bullet and both describes now say "a record change other than a delete or a before-create" and carry the reason and the exception ("…so it links only when the caller wrote the id"). The exception is what the tree does (① above), and it is the one clause the card's own suggested wording lacked; keeping it in the describe is right, because an author who writes `id` on the insert input does get a link.
- Tried to break it: a `record-before-write` flow on its insert leg, a batch insert (per-row `beforeInsert`, same input shape, :5482-5543), a caller-supplied `id` on the input, an `afterInsert` run (after-row carries the id, links as before), a `beforeUpdate` run (`previous` carries the id). The text holds for each.
- **should-fix (a second dialect in the same file).** :435, the `notifyStringSlotSchema` docblock that `NotifySourceIdSlotSchema` (:457) is built from, still reads "An envelope that evaluates to `null` or a blank string leaves the key unset, as a token that resolved to nothing did" — the exact wording the card's `null` clause retires, now sitting 200 lines above a describe that says the pair is "dropped … not defaulted". It is a docblock, not published through `.describe()`, and not one of the two locations the card named, so it is not a FAIL; but the changeset says "the schema say so", and the schema file now says both. One sentence ("…leaves the key unset; it is still a written key, so the pair is dropped rather than defaulted to the trigger record") closes it. The sibling docblock in `notify-node.ts` :694 says the same old sentence — cited code, for the lane seat, not reviewed here.
- **should-fix (cosmetic).** :653-654, the re-wrapped bullet ends a line on "caller wrote the id. An" and starts the next on "explicit pair …", a stranded two-word tail; re-wrap the bullet.

**`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`** — judged against the card's eval surface (`evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` :248-259: a `record-after-update` notify that opens its case, expecting no `sourceObject` / `sourceId` / `actionUrl`) and the spec it teaches on `main`.

- The one edit, :125 `// trigger record (not on delete/before-create), if any`, is the shared enumeration compressed to a comment; the eval's case (`record-after-update`) is unaffected and the expected output still follows from the comment. The comment leaves out the exception (a before-create whose caller wrote the id does link). That reads as over-strict rather than false: an AI following it on a before-create flow writes the pair explicitly, which the runtime honours, or drops when `record.id` resolves to `null` — never a dead link, never a missing one it was promised. Under a 3-token headroom the compression is the right trade; accepted, not a finding.
- Net +0 lines, no re-wrap, so the open overlap with PR #30866 stays disjoint.

No must-fix.

Check-runs on `87404ae2` at the time of this record: 23 completed/success (among them Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Spec property liveness, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · ESLint, Type Check · source gates, Lint & Repo Gates, Build Docs, Dogfood Regression Gate), 8 completed/skipped (opt-in and gated jobs), **0 failure**, 31 still in progress (Test Core 1-8, Test UI 1-16, Type Check · workspace / debt ledger / consumer gates, Type Check UI, Build Core, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI). Every derived gate family that has concluded is green; this verdict stands on those conclusions and on the tree read above. The in-progress runs are the seat's to read at posting: a failure landing on any of them is a gate verdict this record does not override.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：通知节点「三个链接键都不写就默认链到触发记录」的四处文案（spec 的 describe 与 docblock、服务端 notify 节点的说明、Flows 文档、automation 技能示例注释）改为同一说法：删除和 before-create 以外的记录变更才会默认链接；before-create 运行时记录还没有 id，只有调用方自己写了 id 才链接。`sourceId` 写成 `null` 是「写了键但为空」，链接对被丢弃，不回退到触发记录。参考页随之再生成，并新增两条测试钉住这两点。
- 为什么改：原文把所有非删除的记录变更都说成会链接，但 before-create 运行在驱动发 id 之前执行，通知其实没有链接。作者或 AI 会据此省掉链接键，然后等不到链接。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字和测试，运行时行为与 schema 接受集不变；技能文件净增 0 行（token 6443→6446，上限 6449）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` :125，`packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts` 的 notify 链接段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/builtin/notify-node.test.ts`，预期 25/25，含两条新 pin。
- 需要你做的：Tier H（改到 `skills/**`）。请以 os-zhuang 批准 PR #30926；批准后席位落地。契约复审 PASS 记录 6684677358，Head-sha `7cf467745e681280fc3a6a7130f10ec308c61c8c`。

Three patch changesets (`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/skills`) with `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching claim 6683585123.

PASS 6684513754 on `87404ae2` (two should-fixes: the `notifyStringSlotSchema` / `resolveStringSlot` docblocks still carried the retired `null` wording; a stranded line wrap), both fixed in `7cf46774`; delta PASS 6684677358 on `7cf46774`, no findings.
